question: What public reset-start config shape should OpenClaw support for prompt text customization across root session config, per-agent overrides, bootstrap-aware prompts, and acknowledgement-only reset behavior?
rationale: This adds a compatibility-sensitive config surface that changes reset/startup semantics, so automation should not invent a competing key or bypass current bootstrap safeguards.

options.title: Choose one reset-start policy
options.body: Define a single typed policy covering prompt text, startup-turn behavior, current-time/bootstrap preservation, and future greeting/model controls.

options.title: Narrow to prompt text
options.body: Add only a prompt-text override while preserving the current acknowledgement-only default and explicitly documenting bootstrap/current-time precedence.

options.title: Defer new config
options.body: Keep the current hardcoded prompt and route customization through the broader reset greeting and model-policy discussions first.

recommendation.title: Choose one reset-start policy
recommendation.body: Define a single typed policy covering prompt text, startup-turn behavior, current-time/bootstrap preservation, and future greeting/model controls.
